name: data-distributed-storage
description: Use when the user asks about HDFS, S3, ADLS, GCS, MinIO or Ceph for data workloads, replication and erasure coding, small-file problems, storage tiering or lifecycle policies. Produces storage backend choice, layout and durability and cost settings. Not for database storage engines (use database-internals-mechanics) or file formats (use data-formats).
